
{{alias}}( [kind] )
    Returns a list of supported scale names.

    Parameters
    ----------
    kind: string (optional)
        Scale kind. Must be one of the following:

        - all: all scales (default).
        - quantitative: quantitative scales.
        - discrete: discrete scales.
        - discretizing: scales which split a continuous domain into discrete
        segments.

    Returns
    -------
    out: Array<string>
        List of scale names.

    Examples
    --------
    > var out = {{alias}}()
    e.g., [ 'linear', 'log', ... ]
    > out = {{alias}}( 'discrete' )
    [ 'ordinal', 'band', ... ]

    See Also
    --------
